Parent plan: https://chatgpt.com/space/page_0d26b92b5bc8819181fab088efc0283c

## Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add
lib/zaq/channels/email_bridge.ex and email_bridge/smtp_sender.ex. Carry trusted context, prepare all files once around existing deliver_email_reply, compose Swoosh attachments, preserve explicit SMTP connector/recipient/thread headers. Retain resources until synchronous Mailer return.

## Tests to add before implementation
Existing email/SMTP tests: exact binary bytes, multiple files, MIME/filename, malformed internal payload, preparation failure sends nothing, SMTP rejection, sender/recipients/headers and resources live through consumption.

## Branches/paths validated
Zero, one and multiple files; one preparation failure prevents email send; actual sender/recipient receipt; generic and explicit provider error preserved.

## Mocking plan
Existing Swoosh test boundary for composition and external SMTP edge failures; real SMTP receiver in E2E. No global adapter/config replacement.

## Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content
Keep affected module docs accurate. Coordinate the final docs/services/channels.md update and update this issue with evidence/decisions; follow documentation hygiene.

## Action reuse assessment
Extend existing bridge and sender; reuse Swoosh.Attachment/Mailer and selected connector path. Only prepared values reach SMTP helper; no direct paths or URLs from untrusted user payloads and no second materialization.

## Constraints and validation
Read parent settled decisions and applicable repository service, tool-routing, Action reuse and testing policies before implementation. Preserve current test behavior. Follow authoritative validation lifecycle; feature E2E authoring waits for final review task, but focused tests are immediate. Agent selection and #875 acquisition budgets are outside scope. No global configuration mutation.

comments.text: Module-context evidence: EmailBridge.send_reply/2 resolves routing_context channel_config_id to the exact enabled SMTP binding; send_reply_with_smtp owns subject and RFC threading/receipt; deliver_email_reply dispatches existing sender once. SmtpSender owns settings resolution, encrypted SMTP credentials, recipients, Swoosh composition and synchronous Mailer.deliver; DB owns connector config, caller owns prepared binary lifetime, provider owns acceptance. Invariants: prepare all before send, no raw Record paths/URLs sent, unchanged connector/recipients/headers/receipt and provider errors. Existing email_bridge, smtp_sender and threading_headers suites cover zero-file behavior; new isolated integration tests will prove attachment bytes/failure atomicity and existing receipt contract. Action reuse: extend these two boundaries, reuse DeliveryFiles.with_prepared and Swoosh.Attachment/Mailer; no new Action or resource lifecycle. Unknown: lazy trusted-context propagation needs focused integration evidence. Serena overview stalled; bounded targeted read fallback used.

Implementation and self-review complete: shared DeliveryFiles.with_prepared wraps existing sender once; trusted_context separate from allowlisted local node_router; Swoosh data attachments consume only validated prepared maps, preserve order, and retain binary references through synchronous Mailer return. Exact selected connector, recipients, sender, threading and receipt paths unchanged. New async test module authored before production: missing implementation reproduced after fixture corrections, then 6 passed (1 property/5 tests). Validation: mix q passed formatting/hooks/Credo/docs; combined email_bridge, smtp_sender, threading_headers, outgoing_attachments, email_html_delivery, delivery_files, channels/api and engine/messages/outgoing suites passed 282 (5 properties/277 tests), seed 755056, 48.3s. Initial combined invocation was tool-time-limited at 60s without failures; complete rerun passed. git diff --check clean. No existing tests changed, no global configuration mutation, no new module/API/Action/resource lifecycle. Two production files: 44 insertions, 7 deletions; one new test file. Baseline license_manager warning remains. Real SMTP provider receipt/E2E and final coverage/precommit deferred to later epic gates. Parent handles integrate/push/close/sync.

Reviewed focused EmailBridge/SmtpSender diff, no blocking findings. Integrated original agent commit de5d15cee as 8b4a7dae52f57a3d111649aad27f5086c42adc4d. Exact origin/feat/channel-files hash confirmed after push. mix q and commit hooks passed, combined email/SMTP/threading/HTML/helper/API/Outgoing regression group 282 passed (5 properties, 277 tests), diff check passed. Existing test files/scenarios unchanged; new async attachment suite only. Shared preparation all-or-nothing, raw data Swoosh attachments, no paths opened, selected connector/recipients/thread receipt retained. Closing after push confirmation; E2E/coverage/final validation remain later gates.
